headline: Two-digit increase to minimum wage: Conasami
summary: Government, business and labor representatives formally begin discussions on a minimum wage increase, with a rise of two digits under consideration. The talks start on 23 November 2026.
why: The minimum wage sets a floor for labor costs across Mexico's economy, which affects retailers, manufacturers and service firms and can feed into inflation.
original_headline: Aumento al SM de dos dígitos: Conasami
